regle: même espace english.* que la 9ᵉ, subject « english » (décision D5) ; un id neuf seulement quand aucun libellé existant, même élargi, ne dit l'erreur ; rien n'est écrit dans content/misconceptions.json par ce lot : les auteurs B1–B4 appliquent (ajouts et élargissements) dans la PR du premier chapitre qui pose le tag

labels.fr: Tu choisis a ou an d'après la lettre écrite et non d'après le son : an devant un son de voyelle (an amphitheatre, an old garage, an hour), a devant un son de consonne (a cape, a uniform).
labels.en: You choose a or an from the written letter, not from the sound: an before a vowel sound (an amphitheatre, an old garage, an hour), a before a consonant sound (a cape, a uniform).
labels.ar: تختار a أو an حسب الحرف المكتوب لا حسب النطق: an قبل صوت حرف علّة (an amphitheatre, an old garage, an hour) وa قبل صوت حرف ساكن (a cape, a uniform).

labels.fr: Tu choisis l'adjectif possessif d'après la chose possédée ou au hasard : il suit le possesseur (Nadia → her kite, Amine → his kite, the cat → its name, Nadia and Amine → their kite).
labels.en: You choose the possessive adjective from the thing owned or at random: it follows the owner (Nadia → her kite, Amine → his kite, the cat → its name, Nadia and Amine → their kite).
labels.ar: تختار صفة الملكيّة حسب الشيء المملوك أو عشوائيًّا، وهي تتبع المالك: (Nadia → her kite, Amine → his kite, the cat → its name, Nadia and Amine → their kite).

labels.fr: Tu mets un pronom sujet (she, he, they) devant un nom à la place de l'adjectif possessif : she bag ✗ → her bag, They names ✗ → Their names.
labels.en: You put a subject pronoun (she, he, they) before a noun instead of the possessive adjective: she bag ✗ → her bag, They names ✗ → Their names.
labels.ar: تضع ضمير فاعل (she, he, they) قبل الاسم بدل صفة الملكيّة: she bag ✗ → her bag، They names ✗ → Their names.

labels.fr: Tu places mal l'adverbe de fréquence (goes never) : always, usually, sometimes et never se mettent avant le verbe (she never goes) mais après am, is, are (he is always happy).
labels.en: You put the adverb of frequency in the wrong place (goes never): always, usually, sometimes and never go before the verb (she never goes) but after am, is, are (he is always happy).
labels.ar: تضع ظرف التكرار في غير موضعه (goes never): تأتي always وusually وsometimes وnever قبل الفعل (she never goes) وبعد am وis وare (he is always happy).

labels.fr: Tu confonds How many et How much : many devant ce qui se compte, au pluriel (How many eggs?), much devant ce qui ne se compte pas (How much milk?) ; How much? demande aussi un prix.
labels.en: You mix up How many and How much: many before things you can count, in the plural (How many eggs?), much before things you cannot count (How much milk?); How much? also asks for a price.
labels.ar: تخلط بين How many وHow much: many قبل ما يُعدّ بصيغة الجمع (How many eggs?) وmuch قبل ما لا يُعدّ (How much milk?)، وHow much? تسأل أيضًا عن الثمن.

labels.fr: Tu confonds be et have pour parler de la santé : on a une douleur avec have (I have a headache, she has a stomachache) et on est dans un état avec be (I am sick, he is tired).
labels.en: You mix up be and have to talk about your health: you have a pain (I have a headache, she has a stomachache) and you are in a state (I am sick, he is tired).
labels.ar: تخلط بين be وhave عند الحديث عن الصحّة: الألم يُقال بـ have (I have a headache, she has a stomachache) والحالة تُقال بـ be (I am sick, he is tired).

labels.fr: Tu mets le nom à la place de l'adjectif (a cloud day, It's sun) : l'adjectif se forme avec Noun + y (cloudy, sunny, rainy) et suit It's ou se place devant le nom.
labels.en: You use the noun where the adjective is needed (a cloud day, It's sun): the adjective is built with Noun + y (cloudy, sunny, rainy) and comes after It's or before the noun.
labels.ar: تستعمل الاسم مكان الصفة (a cloud day, It's sun): تُبنى الصفة بـ Noun + y (cloudy, sunny, rainy) وتأتي بعد It's أو قبل الاسم.

labels.fr: Tu fabriques le nom du métier en collant -er partout ou sur un mot qui n'est pas un verbe (a carpent, a cooker pour la personne) : Verb + er ne marche qu'avec certains verbes (farm → farmer, build → builder, wait → waiter), les autres métiers s'apprennent tels quels (a doctor, a cook).
labels.en: You build the job name by putting -er everywhere or on a word that is not a verb (a carpent, a cooker for the person): Verb + er only works with some verbs (farm → farmer, build → builder, wait → waiter), other job names are learnt as they are (a doctor, a cook).
labels.ar: تصوغ اسم المهنة بإضافة -er في كلّ موضع أو على كلمة ليست فعلًا (a carpent، وcooker للشخص): لا تصلح Verb + er إلّا مع بعض الأفعال (farm → farmer, build → builder, wait → waiter)، وسائر أسماء المهن تُحفظ كما هي (a doctor, a cook).

labels.fr: Tu formes mal l'impératif : l'ordre commence par la base verbale, sans sujet (Close the door, pas You close the door), et l'interdiction par Don't + base verbale (Don't hit the cat, pas Not hit).
labels.en: You build the imperative wrongly: an order starts with the base verb, with no subject (Close the door, not You close the door), and a prohibition with Don't + base verb (Don't hit the cat, not Not hit).
labels.ar: تخطئ في صيغة الأمر: يبدأ الأمر بالفعل الأصلي دون فاعل (Close the door لا You close the door)، ويبدأ النهي بـ Don't + الفعل الأصلي (Don't hit the cat لا Not hit).

labels.fr: Tu prononces le -ed final comme une syllabe dans tous les verbes : on n'entend /id/ qu'après t ou d (waited, decorated) ; ailleurs il se dit /t/ (talked, danced) ou /d/ (played, hugged).
labels.en: You say the final -ed as an extra syllable in every verb: you only hear /id/ after t or d (waited, decorated); elsewhere it sounds /t/ (talked, danced) or /d/ (played, hugged).
labels.ar: تنطق -ed في آخر الفعل مقطعًا زائدًا في كلّ الأفعال، ولا يُسمع /id/ إلّا بعد t أو d (waited, decorated)، وفي غيرها يُنطق /t/ (talked, danced) أو /d/ (played, hugged).

labels.fr: Tu prononces le mot d'après ses lettres et non d'après le son appris : un h peut être muet (hour, school), un s peut sonner /z/ (plays, museum), des lettres qui se ressemblent peuvent sonner autrement (usually, jeans).
labels.en: You say the word from its letters, not from the sound you learnt: an h can be silent (hour, school), an s can sound /z/ (plays, museum), letters that look alike can sound different (usually, jeans).
labels.ar: تنطق الكلمة حسب حروفها لا حسب الصوت الذي تعلّمته: قد لا يُنطق h (hour, school)، وقد يُنطق s مثل /z/ (plays, museum)، وقد تتشابه الحروف ويختلف الصوت (usually, jeans).

labels.fr: Tu écris mal les centaines : hundred ne prend pas de -s après un nombre (four hundred, pas four hundreds) et and relie les centaines au reste (four hundred and sixty-eight).
labels.en: You write the hundreds wrongly: hundred takes no -s after a number (four hundred, not four hundreds) and and joins the hundreds to the rest (four hundred and sixty-eight).
labels.ar: تخطئ في كتابة المئات: لا تأخذ hundred حرف -s بعد العدد (four hundred لا four hundreds)، وتربط and المئات ببقيّة العدد (four hundred and sixty-eight).

labels.fr: Tu dis I like (= j'aime en général) pour demander poliment ce que tu veux maintenant : au magasin, on dit I would like / I'd like a croissant, please.
labels.en: You say I like (= you enjoy it in general) to ask politely for what you want now: in a shop you say I would like / I'd like a croissant, please.
labels.ar: تقول I like (أي تحبّ الشيء عمومًا) لتطلب بأدب ما تريده الآن، والصواب في المتجر I would like / I'd like a croissant, please.

labels.fr: Tu prends le mot de la paire au sens inverse : buy / sell, win / lose, fit (la taille) / suit (la couleur, le style), clean / dirty… Relis qui fait l'action et ce qu'on décrit.
labels.en: You take the word of the pair with the opposite meaning: buy / sell, win / lose, fit (the size) / suit (the colour, the style), clean / dirty… Read again who does the action and what is described.
labels.ar: تأخذ الكلمة ذات المعنى المعاكس من الزوج: buy / sell، win / lose، fit (المقاس) / suit (اللون والشكل)، clean / dirty… أعد قراءة من يقوم بالفعل وما الذي يُوصف.

labels.fr: Tu choisis un mot du bon thème qui ne nomme pas la chose demandée (bakery pour butcher's, spring pour summer, socks pour gloves) : relis l'indice qui la distingue.
labels.en: You choose a word from the right topic that does not name the thing asked for (bakery for butcher's, spring for summer, socks for gloves): read again the clue that tells them apart.
labels.ar: تختار كلمة من الموضوع الصحيح لكنّها لا تسمّي الشيء المطلوب (bakery بدل butcher's، spring بدل summer، socks بدل gloves): أعد قراءة القرينة التي تميّزه.

labels.fr: Tu te trompes de préposition de temps : on devant un jour (on Monday, on Monday morning, on the weekend), in devant une partie de la journée (in the morning, in the evening), un mois ou une saison (in July, in winter).
labels.en: You choose the wrong preposition of time: on before a day (on Monday, on Monday morning, on the weekend), in before a part of the day (in the morning, in the evening), a month or a season (in July, in winter).
labels.ar: تخطئ في حرف الجرّ الدالّ على الزمن: on قبل اليوم (on Monday, on Monday morning, on the weekend) وin قبل جزء من اليوم (in the morning, in the evening) أو الشهر أو الفصل (in July, in winter).

labels.fr: Tu confonds by et to après travel : by devant le moyen de transport (travel by plane), to devant le lieu où l'on va (travel to Italy).
labels.en: You mix up by and to after travel: by before the means of transport (travel by plane), to before the place you go to (travel to Italy).
labels.ar: تخلط بين by وto بعد travel: by قبل وسيلة النقل (travel by plane) وto قبل المكان المقصود (travel to Italy).

labels.fr: Tu confonds les directions de la carte : north est en haut, south en bas, east à droite, west à gauche ; right et left ne nomment pas une direction de la carte.
labels.en: You mix up the directions on the map: north is at the top, south at the bottom, east on the right, west on the left; right and left do not name a direction of the map.
labels.ar: تخلط بين الاتّجاهات على الخريطة: north في الأعلى وsouth في الأسفل وeast إلى اليمين وwest إلى اليسار، ولا تسمّي right وleft اتّجاهًا من اتّجاهات الخريطة.

labels.fr: Tu fermes le comparatif avec that (warmer that spring) ou sans rien : après un comparatif, on compare avec than (warmer than spring).
labels.en: You close the comparative with that (warmer that spring) or with nothing: after a comparative, you compare with than (warmer than spring).
labels.ar: تختم المقارنة بـ that (warmer that spring) أو تتركها دون رابط، والصواب بعد صيغة المقارنة than (warmer than spring).

elargis.chapitres: 01, 03, 07 (enjoy to swim, How about go, I enjoy walk)

labels.fr: Tu mets to ou la base verbale après like, love, enjoy, hate, dislike, prefer, How about, What about, mind, regret ou une préposition (of, before) : le verbe prend -ing.
labels.en: You use to or the base verb after like, love, enjoy, hate, dislike, prefer, How about, What about, mind, regret or a preposition (of, before): the verb takes -ing.
labels.ar: تستعمل to أو الفعل الأصلي بعد like وlove وenjoy وhate وdislike وprefer وHow about وWhat about وmind وregret أو بعد حرف جرّ (of, before): الفعل يأخذ -ing.

elargis.pourquoi: Ajout de like, love, hate, dislike, prefer, How about (structures de l'unité I, L1 et L3, et de l'unité VII, L3). Note : après like et prefer, to + base est aussi juste (fiche, U-VII L3) ; l'étiquette ne se pose que sur une base nue ou un to après enjoy, hate, dislike, How about, What about.

elargis.chapitres: 05 (she have the right to, we was)

labels.fr: Tu n'accordes pas be, have ou l'auxiliaire avec le sujet : is, was, has, does avec he/she/it ; are, were, have, do avec you/we/they (she has the right to, we were happy).
labels.en: You do not match be, have or the auxiliary with the subject: is, was, has, does with he/she/it; are, were, have, do with you/we/they (she has the right to, we were happy).
labels.ar: لا تطابق be أو have أو الفعل المساعد مع الفاعل: is وwas وhas وdoes مع he/she/it، وare وwere وhave وdo مع you/we/they (she has the right to, we were happy).

elargis.pourquoi: Le libellé disait « auxiliaire » ; en 6ᵉ, has (the right to, a headache) et was/were sont des verbes pleins : on élargit sans changer d'id.

labels.fr: Tu marques le temps ou la personne deux fois : un verbe au passé ne prend pas aussi -s (played, pas playeds), et après do, does ou did (don't, doesn't, didn't) le verbe reste à la base verbale.
labels.en: You mark the tense or the person twice: a past verb does not also take -s (played, not playeds), and after do, does or did (don't, doesn't, didn't) the verb stays in its base form.
labels.ar: تعلّم الزمن أو الشخص مرّتين: لا يأخذ الفعل الماضي -s أيضًا (played لا playeds)، وبعد do وdoes وdid (don't, doesn't, didn't) يبقى الفعل في صيغته الأصلية.

labels.fr: Tu poses la question sans auxiliaire ou avec l'ordre de l'affirmation (How much it is?, When you visited…?) : mot interrogatif + be ou auxiliaire + sujet (+ verbe).
labels.en: You ask the question with no auxiliary or in statement order (How much it is?, When you visited…?): question word + be or auxiliary + subject (+ verb).
labels.ar: تطرح السؤال دون فعل مساعد أو بترتيب الجملة الخبرية (How much it is?, When you visited…?): أداة الاستفهام + be أو المساعد + الفاعل (+ الفعل).

elargis.pourquoi: Ajout de l'exemple de 6ᵉ (How much is it?) et de be.

labels.fr: Tu colles -y, -ing, -ed, -er ou -est sans la règle d'orthographe : consonne doublée (sunny, swimming, stopped, hotter), y → i (tried, happiest), e muet qui tombe (leaving, nicer).
labels.en: You add -y, -ing, -ed, -er or -est without the spelling rule: double consonant (sunny, swimming, stopped, hotter), y → i (tried, happiest), silent e dropped (leaving, nicer).
labels.ar: تضيف -y أو -ing أو -ed أو -er أو -est دون قاعدة الإملاء: مضاعفة الحرف (sunny, swimming, stopped, hotter)، y ← i ‏(tried, happiest)، حذف e الصامتة (leaving, nicer).

elargis.pourquoi: Ajout de -y (Noun + y, U-III L1) et de -ed (U-V L3–L4) ; exemples de 6ᵉ.

labels.fr: Tu oublies le to de would like to, ought to, have to, be able to ou intend to : ces formes le gardent toujours (I would like to buy).
labels.en: You drop the to of would like to, ought to, have to, be able to or intend to: these forms always keep it (I would like to buy).
labels.ar: تحذف to من would like to وought to وhave to وbe able to وintend to: هذه الصيغ تحتفظ بها دائمًا (I would like to buy).

elargis.pourquoi: Ajout de would like to (U-I L5, U-VI L2).
